title: Debiased Conditional Independence Tests for Causal Effects
abstract: arXiv:2611.05608v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose robust tests for causal effects on potentially high-dimensional outcomes where there may be selection into treatment. These tests measure conditional independence of outcomes from treatment assignment by asking whether treatment can be predicted from outcomes more accurately than from covariates alone. We design three such tests of conditional independence. First, we propose a conditional randomization test based on an inverse propensity weighted mean squared error test statistic. If the propensity score is known, the test controls size in finite samples. Second, we propose a double-residualization approach, where we partial out covariate effects from both treatment and outcome-based treatment predictions, and test whether the correlation between the residuals is zero. Third, we propose a test based on an augmented inverse propensity weighted estimator built around doubly robust, Neyman-orthogonal population moments that are n

translated_title: 因果效应的去偏条件独立性检验
translated_abstract: 我们针对可能存在处理选择偏差、结果变量可能为高维的情形，提出了稳健的因果效应检验方法。这些检验通过考察“从结果变量预测处理分配是否比仅从协变量预测更准确”来衡量结果变量与处理分配之间的条件独立性。我们设计了三种这样的条件独立性检验。第一，我们提出了一种基于逆倾向得分加权均方误差统计量的条件随机化检验；若倾向得分已知，该检验可在有限样本中控制检验水平。第二，我们提出了一种双重残差化方法，即从处理变量和基于结果的处理预测中分别剔除协变量的影响，然后检验两个残差之间的相关性是否为零。第三，我们提出了一种基于增广逆倾向得分加权估计量的检验，该估计量构建于双稳健、Neyman正交的总体矩之上……
tldr: 该论文针对存在处理选择偏差和高维结果的情形，提出了三种稳健的条件独立性检验方法——基于逆倾向加权统计量的条件随机化检验、双重残差化检验以及基于双稳健Neyman正交矩的增广逆倾向加权检验——用于因果效应检验。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes three robust conditional independence tests for causal effects under treatment selection and potentially high-dimensional outcomes: a conditional randomization test based on inverse propensity weighted statistics, a double-residualization test, and a test based on an augmented inverse propensity weighted estimator built on doubly robust, Neyman-orthogonal moments.
